subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land the fresh-session recook mitigation now, or should accepted-disconnect handling be redesigned to reattach before any local retry?
rationale: Both choices avoid same-session collision, but they differ in duplicate tool execution, delivery behavior, terminal responsiveness, and whether transcript-tail recovery is reliable enough to represent the accepted run.

options.title: Land the narrow mitigation
options.body: Fix the import cycle, retain fresh-session fallback as a last resort, and decide reattach-first behavior in the linked issue.

options.title: Expand to reattach-first
options.body: Hold this PR and implement authoritative accepted-run recovery before permitting an embedded retry.

options.title: Return without retry
options.body: Report the accepted run as in flight and avoid local duplication at the cost of no immediate local result.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow mitigation
recommendation.body: Fix the import cycle, retain fresh-session fallback as a last resort, and decide reattach-first behavior in the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core agent CLI behavior and fallback-policy choice rather than a mechanical code repair.
